systems.name: 5.1 Procedural Dungeon Generation
systems.notes: Each chapter features a procedurally generated dungeon with rooms, corridors, and set pieces. Dungeons must support stealth gameplay with multiple paths.
tasks: Implement BSP or room-placement dungeon generator
Generate multiple room types (chamber, hallway, vault, crypt)
Place interactive objects (chests, crates, torches, traps)
Ensure multiple viable paths through each dungeon

systems.name: 5.2 Environmental Traps & Hazards
systems.notes: Place traps throughout the dungeon. The Mimic can use them for ambushes. Ghosts can trigger them against the Mimic.
tasks: Trap types: spike pits, poison gas, falling rocks, flame jets
Trap triggers: pressure plates, tripwires, proximity
Mimic can bait players into traps

systems.name: 5.3 Prop & Object System
systems.notes: Populate dungeons with objects the Mimic can possess. Objects should be varied and naturally placed.
tasks: Object types: chests, crates, barrels, torches, statues, armour stands
Object placement logic: natural clusters, varied density
Objects must have collision and LOS-blocking properties
Visual polish: objects look like normal dungeon props
